name: NUNDINA Pilot Credit Sleeve
description: Pilot asset for the NUNDINA mechanism, used to prove gated, NAV-priced private-credit rails. AS-BUILT (devnet): thaws route through Token ACL to credit-gate; mint, permanent-delegate and metadata authority are a Squads 2-of-2 vault; supply is matched 1:1 by USDC deposited by hand. TARGET-STATE, not in force: backing enforced by code. PILOT-DEMO-ASSET — NOT AN OFFER — SYNTHETIC LABEL. Not a protocol token; no distribution, no vesting, no emissions.
